canonical_project: Incheon Airport AI Innovation Hub data center (IBC-II, near Terminal 2)
notes: IIAC 'AI Innovation Hub' plan announced Dec 2024: 156,000 sqm IBC-II district by 2040; phase 1 AI DC on 17,611 sqm up to 40MW with operator public tender (Jan 2025); Nov 2025 operator recruitment for 23,000 sqm site with up to 50-yr operating rights and up to KRW 1.5tn project; May 2026 pursuing 40MW DC plus 5MW GPU cluster and AI company attraction.
